posts.title: Ardennes Sketches 2026
posts.description: I've started experimenting with urban sketching using ink and watercolor (also called “Ink and Wash” or “Line and Wash”). Since I was going on a short holiday to the Belgian Ardennes, I thought I would do some urban sketching there.
